exposure: Mode of conception (IVF vs naturally conceived)
outcome: Gestational complications (PIH, PIDM, placenta previa, premature rupture of membranes, intrahepatic cholestasis, premature delivery, twin transfusion syndromes)
cohort: 1200 women with twin pregnancy and a gestational age >=28 weeks who delivered at the Tianjin Central Hospital of Gynecology Obstetrics between January 2013 and December 2016.
finding: The clinical outcomes of test-tube twins and naturally-conceived twins were basically similar, except for higher rates of pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) and pregnancy-induced diabetes mellitus (PIDM) in the test-tube group.
